prior: CB3 has 16/16 four-relevant-feature-set recovery and 5/16 exact content-vs-gate roles with unrestricted four-feature 16-bin Boolean rules, because passive role partition is not identifiable under arbitrary input permutation.
research_question: Does an independently observed mechanism-state response under actively selected feature interventions distinguish feature role, when passive action/reward observations cannot?

source.worlds: new PUBLIC seeds 82400..82431 inclusive, 32 worlds, each of 4 structures repeated 8x. No original FKP17, DG1, MD35 or other owner-held cohort.
source.parent_feature_basis: 8 uint4 public state registers + prior and older 3-bit action features, 38 total; all 4 source-relevant features in state-register bits 0..31 to allow physically meaningful present-state feature toggles.
source.behavioral_rule: Binary rewarded action = x XOR y XOR indicator(2*x+y == 2*g0+g1) for source-private content bits x,y and gate bits g0,g1; evaluator-only rule. Gate/content labels never passed to either learner.
source.earned_feedback: 515 source-public state/action/after/reward/history steps per world, reward at t belongs to action t-2 (three warmup zero), 512 genuinely credited examples, 0/1 action within eight-action public schema. Shared seeded random exploratory actions, never oracle-labeled counterfactuals.
source.intervention: After each source-blind learner fits four relevant feature indices, it may select a physical public CURRENT-state bit j in 0..31 and issue an intervention toggling bit j on a resettable public baseline state. The source returns only (public state before, addressed bit j, public state after, public mediator bit before and after, physically charged cost=1); mediator M=x XOR y, so do-flipping a content parent changes M and a gate parent does not. M is a separate observable mechanism readout, absent from earlier CB3 passive stream. Actual source-private feature IDs/roles/alternative target rewards remain hidden.
source.probe_seed: random.Random(seed+3000) public baseline state for each intervention, evaluator computes mediator only after requested action. Source closes at max3 probes per world per arm. Both arms share same baseline and action opportunities; models get only their own real public probe reports.
source.evaluation: After paid probes, each arm commits to two content and two gate indices. Source-owner compares role assignments on all 32 worlds and scores 128 independently seeded unseen public action contexts/world, without passing labels to learners. Full transparency that mediator adds distinguishing information not in CB3.

arms.candidate: Reuse unchanged CB3 DiscoveredGateBinder to identify unordered four-feature set via 512 earned delayed outcomes, then an explicit source-blind constrained diagnostic: probe the two smallest learned indices; if both observed mediator changes agree, stop with known 2-content cardinality; otherwise probe the third and infer the fourth. No source-private indices or mediator function in learner.
arms.conventional: Reuse unchanged CB3 separately implemented exhaustive ConventionalExhaustiveFour to identify unordered four-feature set, then independently maintain six candidate 2-content partitions, update likelihood by each real paid mediator response; same chosen feature order/budget and information/actions.
arms.no_intervention: Use CB3 direct learner's old (base_pair,gate_pair) grouping with no new evidence; diagnostic only, not comparable-paid arm.
arms.shuffled_feedback: Correct four-feature set, but attribute each observed mediator change to the next feature rather than the actually intervened feature; negative control with same opportunities.
arms.oracle: Evaluator-only private role labels to establish 100% possible goal, never train.

budgets.candidate_checkpoint_bytes: existing CB3 checkpoint 78 bytes plus <=128-byte role assignment proof, no cache or opaque driver used for native model
budgets.random_seeds: source seeds fixed; 1000 world-cluster paired bootstrap seed 82490

prespecified_outcomes.four_relevant_features: candidate and independent conventional exact source set at least 30/32 worlds, otherwise FAIL_NO_IDENTIFIABLE_GATE_SEARCH
prespecified_outcomes.source_role_assignment: candidate exactly 2 content and 2 gate feature IDs at least 30/32 and conventional at least 30/32, each no more than 3 paid interventions, after source-private owner audit only
prespecified_outcomes.improvement_over_passive: candidate exact role success - no-intervention exact role success >= 0.35 absolute
prespecified_outcomes.negative_control: shuffled feedback exact role accuracy <=0.70; if fails, report but no postscore fixture change
prespecified_outcomes.unseen_behavior: both learner models at least 0.95 mean action correctness on 32×128 truly unseen contexts; this is due prior CB3 fitted Boolean rule, not causal-role identification proof
prespecified_outcomes.matched_strong_control_superiority: candidate minus conventional role accuracy >=0.05 AND paired bootstrap 95% lower bound >0.01. Otherwise unique scientific benefit NO-GO regardless of intervention-role gate PASS.
prespecified_outcomes.engineering: focused exact-source tests verify delayed feedback/custody, no false positive role, actual before/after state bit flip only, no hidden private fields, probe charging, budget refusal, cold checksum identity and no learner imports from source, deterministic same world outcomes
prespecified_outcomes.novelty_limit: Identifiability only in this purpose-built mediator-generating family with explicit two-of-four content constraint; extra paid mediator observable breaks former permutation symmetry. Does NOT prove autonomous creation of operators, natural-world causal discovery, return-optimal active exploration, native Yggdrasil intelligence or RSI.
prespecified_outcomes.stop: Freeze original public score; preserve all null/negative controls without tuning on the now-consumed 32 worlds. No merging or native promotion absent independent disjoint private first use, fully trained conventional controls and exact cross-platform full qualification.
